## fingerprint

```yaml
what_it_is: 'A deep reinforcement learning method for multi-agent collision avoidance
  that induces socially compliant navigation behaviors through reward shaping. The
  method trains a symmetrical multiagent neural network with a norm-inducing reward
  penalty to learn cooperation-free collision avoidance policies that respect social
  norms (e.g., passing on the right).

  '
positive_signals:
- a value network or policy trained from rewards for collision avoidance (deep V-learning
  / deep RL), not a tree search, roadmap, or optimization solver
- reward shaping or penalty terms that induce a navigation norm (passing / overtaking
  / crossing side preferences)
- multi-agent joint-state input with weight-sharing, max-pooling, or another permutation-invariant
  neighbor aggregation
route_elsewhere:
- signal: the paper contributes a general single-agent RL training method; navigation/collision
    avoidance is just its benchmark
  to: CLC-RL/single_agent_rl
- signal: the method computes trajectories by sampling/search rather than learning
    a closed-loop policy from rewards
  to: CLC-MP/sampling_based_planner
worked_examples:
- "SA-CADRL (Chen et al. 2017) \u2014 the source paper"
- "CADRL (Chen et al. 2016) \u2014 the norm-free deep-RL collision-avoidance predecessor\
  \ the source paper extends (its reference [14])"
```
